scene: The tuned dish crackles, projecting a flickering hologram into the chilly air.
picture: Flat side view along the rooftop ground line. On the far left hangs a copper antenna wire. The boy with dark curly hair and glasses stands left-centre, hands near the glowing satellite dish at centre which projects a holographic cat. On the far right, a tall radio mast has a ladder bolted to it.
shown: a flickering neon holographic cat floating right above the dish at centre
a dangling copper antenna wire swaying gently on the far left
an upright metal ladder bolted to the radio mast on the far right
